name: ABP 692
sort_evidence: ABP 692 is Amgen's proposed biosimilar to Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) in a Phase 3 PK/PD comparison in RRMS (NCT06700343, active not recruiting); the biosimilar itself is unapproved and not in the AMGN book (https://www.pearceip.law/2025/01/13/amgens-ocrelizumab-biosimilar-in-phase-3-trials/).
